Title: A question on function of Safe Passage

Messages.Author: Khalid1988
Messages.Body:
With the latest RTR changes, can powers like Discern be used without the additional cost when a Safe Passage is played? Discern's card type is still a power and not a reaction card after all.

> Name: Safe Passage
> [HttB:C/B2]
> Cardtype: Action Modifier
> Discipline: Obeah/Fortitude
> [for] Allies get -1 intercept.
> [obe] As [for] above, and reaction cards cost 1 additional blood or life this action.
> [OBE] As [obe] above, and put this card on this vampire. Actions against this vampire cost 1 additional blood or life. Burn this card during your unlock phase.
> Artist: Jim DiBartolo
>
> Name: Discern
> [NoR:C]
> Cardtype: Power
> Virtue: Judgment
> [REACTION]+1 intercept. Only usable when a monster is acting.
> Artist: Thomas Manning
>
Prince of Tikkurila, known as Teemu P in Lackey CCG

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Khalid1988 wrote:
> With the latest RTR changes, can powers like Discern be used without the additional cost when a Safe Passage is played? Discern's card type is still a power and not a reaction card after all.
>
Yes, Discern is not a reaction card.

Prince of Paris, France
